method: Native WebGL canvas.captureStream at 8 requested fps plus the real game AudioContext limiter output via MediaStreamDestination. Recorded live, no replacement sound, normalization or post soundtrack. Explicit test stations and accelerated pre-roll climate settling; synthetic pre-roll event logs discarded before native recording to avoid an audio burst. Recorded lightning/thunder thereafter use the ordinary event scheduler and distance/343. These inspections are distinct from the uninterrupted walk.
